g.text: n = 14 randomised controlled trials · ordered by overall judgment (low → some concerns → high)
Figure S5b: Risk of Bias Assessment — RoB 2
RoB 2: Revised Cochrane risk-of-bias tool for randomised trials.
D1, bias arising from the randomisation process; D2, bias due to deviations from intended interventions;
D3, bias due to missing outcome data; D4, bias in measurement of the outcome; D5, bias in selection of the reported result.
Overall: 1 low, 11 some concerns, 2 high. ● = Low; ? = Some concerns; ✕ = High.
